corrections.text: The article's own reading of the Codex engine's isolation.ts says it sets a dangerFullAccess sandbox policy for an agent's turn and a read-only policy with network access off for helper turns. The file also makes a turn read-only when its working folder overlaps the app server's own folder (its header comment says an agent's turn runs with full access 'outside the server's own folder'), and the reading was made at repository commit 4636b84, which is three commits after the v0.3.5 tag; the project's 12 November release note says no source snapshot matched to the shipped desktop binaries has been published yet. The reading therefore describes the code at that commit, not necessarily the released builds.
